description: For each country in a work history: whether a pension is likely to exist and why, the official free routes first, what is hard from abroad and any dated obligation that applies. Years may be exact, rough or unknown.

birthYear.description: Optional. Year of birth, four digits. Used for age-dependent rules.

countryOfResidence.description: Optional. Where the person lives now. For a country they live in, what is hard from abroad is left out.

entries.description: One entry per period of work in a country.

country.description: A country: English or native name, alias or ISO code, for example NL or Netherlands.

employer.description: Employer name as the person knows it. Optional.

from.description: First year of work: four digits, rough words such as "around 2005" or "the 1990s", or "unknown". Optional.

pensionType.description: Optional. state, workplace, provident or personal.

status.description: Optional. citizen, permanent_resident, pass_holder or unknown. Decides some verdicts, such as Singapore CPF.

to.description: Last year, in the same forms, or "now". Omit when from alone describes the period.

language.description: Optional. Language of our own sentences, default en: en, ar, da, de, es, fa, fr, hi, id, it, ja, ko, nb, nl, pl, pt, pt-BR, ro, ru, sv, th, tl, tr, zh, vi, uk, bg. Facts stay as stored.

question.description: Optional. The person's question in plain words, used only to tell which kind of pension it is about.

subject.description: Optional facts about the person, used only to decide which dated obligations apply.

birthYear.description: Optional. Year of birth, four digits. Used for age-dependent rules.

childrenMentioned.description: True when children are part of the question.

deceased.description: True when the person has died and a relative is asking.

pensionInPaymentCountries.description: Countries already paying the person a pension.

items.description: Countries already paying the person a pension.

name: check_work_history
title: Check a work history
